rationale: The registry declares outputStrategy and outputStrategyDeclared 'custom_pleading' for this track with compositionMode null.

The mechanism recorded on the track is explicit: "There is no official form. The Clean Slate portal states plainly that a petition must be filed under § 54-142v or § 54-142d and that no official form exists, and the statute specifies exactly what the petition must contain."
packetSet.components lists two custom_pleading components and no officialFormId, so no official form dependency is drafted or blocked for this track.

primaryStatutoryAuthority.description: Erasure for certain cannabis convictions. The petition vehicle for the three eligible conviction categories.
Required content: a copy of the arrest record or a supporting affidavit.
The court shall direct erasure if the petition is in order.
The multi-count bar: records referencing more than one count unless every count is entitled to erasure.

counselFlags.statement: There is no statewide form for a § 54-142v petition, and G.A. clerks may have local expectations about caption and format. The caption in this config is a token pattern taken from the destination the registry records ("Superior Court, Judicial District or G.A. location") and from the illustrative caption in the compiled profile; it is not a confirmed accepted caption.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Confirm with a Connecticut practitioner what caption and format the G.A. clerks actually accept, since no form exists and practice will vary.

counselFlags.statement: No service requirement was found in § 54-142v and local practice must be confirmed. A short proposed order is recommended but no form exists and clerk acceptance is unconfirmed. This config therefore sets includeCertificateOfService=false and includeProposedOrder=false and asserts no service or order text.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Whether a § 54-142v petition must be served on anyone, and whether a proposed order should be filed with it and in what form.

counselFlags.statement: The affidavit is sworn, but the source review does not state whether a notary or another proper officer is required, and states no verification statute for the petition itself. verificationStatute.citation is null rather than invented.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: The required verification/notarization form for the petition and the affidavit, and the officer who must take the oath.

counselFlags.statement: § 54-142v(b) bars relief for records referencing more than one count unless every count is entitled to erasure. LegalEase never asserts that all counts on the docket are erasable unless the participant has confirmed the count list from the record.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That screening captures the participant's own confirmation of the full count list from the Judicial Branch case look-up before the all-counts allegation is populated.

counselFlags.statement: The quantity possessed, distributed or grown, and any characterization of what paraphernalia was used for, are the petitioner's sworn facts. LegalEase drafts the container; it never generates or estimates the quantity or the paraphernalia-use fact.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That the affidavit container is never populated from anything other than the participant's own sworn answer.

counselFlags.statement: This petition must not assert that the offense has been decriminalized. That is the § 54-142d question and it carries case law; it is a separate track and a separate remedy.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That no allegation of decriminalization is rendered in a § 54-142v petition.

counselFlags.statement: Connecticut says erasure. Not expungement, not sealing. The compiled profile's terminology block nevertheless carries primaryConsumerTerm 'expungement' with avoidUniversalExpungementLabel=true; the state term governs all output for this track.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That rendered output and participant copy use 'erasure' only.

counselFlags.statement: After filing, the court will either order erasure without a hearing or schedule a hearing. A procedural hearing does not block generation; disputed facts or a contested hearing trigger handoff to counsel.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: That the handoff trigger is wired to disputed facts and contested hearings, not to the mere scheduling of a hearing.

counselFlags.statement: Track legalStatus is 'legal_review_pending' and legalDesignStatus is 'legal_design_approved_with_limitations'. Runtime is disabled: counsel approved the design, not the produced document; output review, visual review and technical proof are all outstanding.
counselFlags.mustConfirm: Output review, visual review and technical proof before this pleading leaves internal review.
